newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Q1 c/account deficit A$4.587 bln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Q1 c/account deficit A$4.587 bln.

text.p: Australia's current account deficit narrowed to A$4.587 billion in the March quarter from A$5.262 billion in the December quarter (revised from A$5.346 billion), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
Australia's net exports in the March quarter made a positive contribution of 0.6 percentage points to expenditure-based gross domestic product (GDP), the Bureau said.

The seasonally adjusted balance of trade in goods and services showed a surplus of A$864 million in 1989/90 prices, from a surplus of A$244 million (revised from a surplus of A$30 million) in the previous quarter. In volume terms, exports of goods and services rose two percent, while imports were steady.

The bureau said the unadjusted March quarter capital account surplus of A$2.255 billion in current prices was made up of A$1.603 billion of net debt financing and A$1.303 billion of net equity financing. Net other financing was A$651 million.
